system.description:
You spin, around striking any and everything that stands in your path. Make three Taijutsu attacks comparing the results vs the AC of all each creature in range. On a hit you deal your [Weapons damage] + 3d6. Affected creatures must make a Strength Saving throw if they are struck at least once. If you crit with this attack all creatures make their saves at disadvantage.

On a failed save, echoes of your weapon strikes repeat each blow as the affected creatures becomes Bruised.

Chain 2: Creatures in range who are Prone when the attacks are made and fail their saving throw are Stunned until the end of their next turn.

Chain 3: Your strike are so swift and aggressive that you maintain the momentum that each strike had, granting you a +20 bonus to your speed until the end of the current turn. Additionally, you can cast another Bukijutsu as a Bonus Action this turn with a Casting time of 1 Action. If cast in this way, that jutsu has its cost reduced by half.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost by 3, the damage by 1d6.
